new.tovw: Lead grade F: the gold was dug up by post laborers; one reminiscence; historic site, look only
new.n: Angell's buried gold found under the new post foundations, Fort Snelling
new.pl: Historic Fort Snelling; the new post buildings where it was found are not identified
new.st: A man named Angell, come down from the Red River settlement, buried 'a considerable quantity of gold' at Fort Snelling and died without recovering it; it 'slept in the ground for over fifty years' until laborers digging foundations for new post buildings turned it up (Mrs. Adams' reminiscences, Minnesota Historical Collections). Found; the fort is a state historic site. Pin is the fort, not the spot.
new.t: Found long ago; Historic Fort Snelling is a protected site. Look only.
src: Collections of the Minnesota Historical Society, Mrs. Adams' reminiscences, pp. 100-101 (approx.; volume not recorded)
pinev: On the atlas's existing Historic Fort Snelling point (44.8928, -93.1809); r400 takes in the old fort and the nearby post grounds.
